name: project-brain
description: A self-organising project memory that learns which decisions, conventions and fixes matter and recalls them like a neural network.

inject.title: Recall into prompts
inject.description: Add the memories that matter for each prompt as context Claude reads (once per conversation each).

tokenBudget.title: Context budget (tokens)
tokenBudget.description: The most a recalled-memories note may add to a prompt, in tokens (about 4 characters each).

useModel.title: Learn with a small model
useModel.description: In the background, ask a small model to pull decisions, conventions and lessons out of finished turns and to summarise clusters while idle.

model.title: Model for learning
model.description: The model alias or id used for background extraction and summaries.

modelCallsPerHour.title: Model calls per hour
modelCallsPerHour.description: Rate limit for the background model calls (0 turns them off).

halfLifeDays.title: Forgetting half-life (days)
halfLifeDays.description: An association not used for this many days loses half its strength.

maxNodes.title: Memory size cap
maxNodes.description: The most memories (nodes) kept per project, up to 6000; the weakest are pruned during consolidation. Links are capped at ten times this.

idleMinutes.title: Sleep after (minutes idle)
idleMinutes.description: Minutes without a prompt before the brain consolidates (merges duplicates, prunes, summarises).
